brief: Gives information about a file path (name, size, suffix, times, flags) without opening the file for reading.
detail: Reach for it to ask what a file is: Info gives a summary hash list, and the single readers (Size, Suffix, BaseName, DirPath, Exists) give one fact each. The path is kept as given and nothing is resolved. Two traps today: IsWritable opens the path for appending, so asking about a missing file creates it empty (and Info does so too), and IsExecutable answers 0 for every file. CreationTime and LastReadingTime raise an error on purpose.
receiver:
write("demo_note.txt", "alpha" + char(10) + "beta gamma" + char(10) + "end")
o1 = new stzFileInfo("demo_note.txt")
